title: 别董大·其一
author: 高适
intro: A farewell on a cold, windy day that turns gloom into encouragement: don’t worry about having no friends ahead — everyone under heaven knows you.
analysis: 这是高适送别朋友董大时写的诗。董大是当时有名的琴师董庭兰，“大”是他在兄弟中排行第一。前两句写送别时的天气：千里天空都是昏黄的云，太阳也暗淡无光；北风呼呼地吹，大雁南飞，大雪纷纷落下。这样阴冷的景色，本来最容易让人伤感。可后两句却一下子振作起来：不要担心前面的路上没有知心朋友，天下哪个人不认识你呢？一般的送别诗多写依依不舍、伤心落泪，这首诗却用豪迈的语气安慰和鼓励朋友。当时高适和董大都很不得志，生活贫困，诗人还能说出这么有力量的话，更让人感动。“莫愁前路无知己，天下谁人不识君”今天仍常用来为远行的人送上祝福。
analysisEn: Gao Shi wrote this when parting from his friend Dong Da — the famous zither player Dong Tinglan; “Da” (“eldest”) means he was the first-born son. The first two lines describe the day: for a thousand li the sky is full of yellowish clouds and the sun is dim; the north wind blows, wild geese head south, and snow falls thick and fast. A bleak scene like that usually leads to sad goodbyes. But the second half suddenly lifts: don’t worry that you’ll have no true friends on the road ahead — who under heaven doesn’t know you? Most farewell poems dwell on tears and reluctance; this one cheers the friend on in a bold, generous voice. At the time both men were poor and out of luck, which makes the encouragement even more moving. The last two lines are still used today to send someone off on a long journey with good wishes.
background: Gao Shi (c. 704–765) was a Tang poet best known for frontier poems; unusually for a poet, he later rose to high office. He wrote two poems for Dong Tinglan, a celebrated qin player, around 747, when both were struggling; this is the first.
pronunciation: 谁 按教材通行注音读 shuí（口语也读 shéi）。曛 xūn（生僻字）。识 shí。
version: 采用通行教材文本，与《全唐诗》一致。首句有异文“十里黄云白日曛”，网站用教材的“千里黄云”。原作两首，这是第一首。

lines.py: qiān lǐ huáng yún bái rì xūn
lines.lit: A thousand li of yellow clouds; the white sun is dim;
lines.en: Yellow clouds for a thousand miles, the sun gone dim;

lines.py: běi fēng chuī yàn xuě fēn fēn
lines.lit: the north wind blows the geese; snow falls thick and fast.
lines.en: the north wind drives the geese through falling snow.

lines.py: mò chóu qián lù wú zhī jǐ
lines.lit: Don’t worry that on the road ahead there are no true friends;
lines.en: Don’t fear the road ahead will hold no friends —

lines.py: tiān xià shuí rén bù shí jūn
lines.lit: under heaven, who does not know you?
lines.en: is there anyone under heaven who doesn’t know you?

words.note: 古人常用排行称呼人，“大”就是老大。

words.en: yellowish clouds (dark with dust and snow)

words.note: 生僻字；本义是落日的余光。

words.en: thick and fast; one after another
words.note: 现代汉语常用，如“议论纷纷”。
古义“不要”，现代汉语“莫非”“莫名其妙”。
现代汉语也说“前路”“前途”。

words.en: a true friend who understands you
words.note: 现代汉语仍常用，如“知己朋友”。
古代对人的尊称，相当于“您”。

imagery.name: 云
imagery.zh: 满天昏黄的云写出送别时阴沉的天气，也是离别时沉重心情的底色。
imagery.en: A sky full of dull yellow clouds sets a gloomy scene — the heavy backdrop of parting.

imagery.name: 白日
imagery.zh: 太阳也变得昏暗，天色压抑，衬托后面的豪言更显得有力量。
imagery.en: Even the sun is dim; against such a dark sky, the bold words that follow ring out all the stronger.

imagery.name: 雁
imagery.zh: 北风中南飞的大雁，像即将远行的朋友，也带着漂泊之感。
imagery.en: Geese flying south in the north wind are like the friend about to set out — travellers with no fixed home.

imagery.name: 雪
imagery.zh: 纷纷大雪写出冬天的寒冷和旅途的艰难。
imagery.en: Heavy snow shows the cold of winter and how hard the journey will be.
